response.reason: The rational-approximation coefficients are truncated to ~5 significant digits, so the achieved absolute error exceeds the required 1e-6: evaluating the kernel's own Horner form at the middle-branch endpoint (x = 1+sqrt(2), z = sqrt(2)-1, s = 3-2*sqrt(2)) gives value = pi/4 + z*(1 + s*P(s)/Q(s)) ≈ 1.1781005 vs the exact 3*pi/8 = 1.1780972, an error of roughly 3e-6, and similarly ~2e-6 near x = 0.66; FP32 rounding is negligible, so the coefficient truncation is the dominant defect.
